note: PUBLIC Ed25519 keys only. A seat mints its own key with scripts/seat_keygen.py (private key stays on the seat, outside the repo) and the operator pastes the printed row under seats. Set "revoked": true to cut a seat off. Checked by mag/seat_handshake.py (warm MCP doors) and mag/proposals.py (seat-to-seat proposals).

quorum.note: distinct allowlisted seats (author excluded) whose approve reviews mark a proposal ready; an approve from an operator_seats member marks it ready alone (operator override).
quorum.grokbot_note: 2026-10-18: seats with kind/model_family grokbot (ids grokbot-*) count toward quorum.default but satisfy require_non_glm_approval ONLY when grokbot_counts_as_non_glm is true (mag/proposals.py is_non_glm_seat). Default false: a Grok Bot seat cannot silently co-adopt mate harness changes.
